population.classification: young growing dairy-cross-beef cattle; not a mature-cow cohort

ageAtFirstObservedIntervalDays.method: For each official tag, age at its earliest Date_From, computed as Date_From minus DOB.

split.scope: later cohorts on the same six North Wyke plots; not new-farm generalization

evaluation.target: published DLWG reconciled to (end liveweight - start liveweight) / elapsed days

baseline.method: mean observed DLWG from training cohorts 1–3, evaluated on the same cohort-4 animal-period rows

animalClusterBootstrap.method: 10,000 percentile bootstrap replicates sampling held-out animals with replacement; all animal-period rows for each sampled animal stay together
animalClusterBootstrap.resamplingUnit: animal Tag_Official; repeated periods remain clustered within animal
animalClusterBootstrap.limitation: These intervals quantify resampling variability in aggregate metrics within this study only; they are not predictive intervals and do not account for dependence shared by year or the six plots.

limitations: This tests only the ADG component and uses no parameter fitting; it is not full validation of engine.js.
The engine receives only starting weight and days; observed plot, grazing treatment, herbage mass, weather, diet quality and intake are not mapped into the simulation.
The held-out cohort shares the same six plots and research site with training cohorts; the split is temporal and animal-disjoint, not new-farm validation.
The source audit calculates first-observed age from DOB for 248 official tags: 173–747 days (median 231); this is a young cohort, not mature cows.
Rothamsted is a temperate dairy-cross beef system and is not directly representative of the approved USDA/CPER population or Brazilian beef production.
DLWG is derived from the start/end liveweights and elapsed days, so it is not an independent outcome from those measurements.
The result does not validate DMI, costs, pasture stock, confinement comparisons, or prediction intervals; keep product status as sem calibração suficiente.
